newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares drift lower, portfolio sales lift volume.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares drift lower, portfolio sales lift volume.

text.p: * NZ index drifts off after firm start
* Big line in Lyttelton Port boosts turnover
* Brokers report portfolio sale "in the market" ---------------------------(April 24)---------------------------
LAST CHG 129 nil * NZSE-40 cap index -2.46
at 2,252.09 310 -1 * NZSC cap index +2.78 at 4,964.12 298 +2 * NZSE-10 cap index +2.12 at 1,109.38 352 -4 * Volume NZ$31 million. Futures untraded 653 -3 * Other movers - -30 +2
New Zealand share prices opened marginally firmer on Thursday but then softened slightly. After 45 minutes trading the NZSE40 Capital index was down 2.46 points at 2,252.09.
Brokers said a portfolio in the market and a line of 7.8 million Lyttelton Port shares at $1.90 helped boost turnover.
"We opened down and a bit mixed, with Telecom a bit weaker and Fletcher Paper a bit firmer, following interest on positive views on pulp internationally," Tim Preston of brokers ANZ Securities said.
"Overall going into the long weekend the market is looking forward to March profit results."
Friday is Anzac Day, a remembrance day holiday.
Preston said there did not seem to be a lot of orders in the market, other than the portfolio and the Lyttelton Port shares.
"There is a portfolio reported in the market. I don't know whether it is on the buy or sell side," he said.
